currentWork.title: FINAL.29 dedicated tollways extra — validated, ready for production release
currentWork.releaseStatus: PR #156 final clean head 90c4a487a6d68b418029e4e9377e0bea177e1de3 is validated. Vercel Preview dpl_2rKPYSXETn64FteYT8hM85rUsoUL is READY and the temporary provider probe was removed. Production remains FINAL.28 until merge.
rootCause: Field evidence on FINAL.28 showed the route status itself said 高速・有料区間なし. That means the client was not receiving a priority classification for the actual returned route, so drawing/cache fixes alone could not solve the case.
The relay requested only ORS waycategory. ORS exposes dedicated tollways extra information separately from waycategory, and the relay was not requesting or forwarding it.
waytype is intentionally not used as a red classifier because waytype=1 includes primary/trunk as well as motorway and would create false-positive red ordinary roads.
scope: Forward sanitized tollways spans through the relay.
Merge waycategory Highway/Tollways bits with dedicated tollways=1 spans when splitting route geometry.
A span is red when motorway or tollway evidence exists from either source; ordinary spans remain blue.
The FINAL.29 browser fixture explicitly reproduces waycategory=0 with tollways=1 and requires the toll span to render red and the summary to say 有料区間あり.
FINAL.28 routing-asset version matching, FINAL.27 fullscreen PIN/detail behavior, HGV profile semantics, Analytics, DB/schema, tasks, orders, visits and user data remain unchanged.
